HEADLINE: The Board of Directors initiated discussions and evaluation on the agenda item pertaining to fund raising by way of issue of securities/instruments. However, due to the requirement for ....
MORE:
The Board of Directors initiated discussions and evaluation on the agenda item pertaining to fund raising by way of issue of securities/instruments. However, due to the requirement for detailed examination and further deliberations on various structural and commercial modalities, the discussion could not be concluded in today's meeting and no final decision/outcome could be arrived at.

Accordingly, the Board has decided to defer the matter and conduct further discussions on the fund-raising proposal at the upcoming Board Meeting scheduled on Thursday, November 5, 2026.
